fold.quote: There's no denying that the Full Fat is a big trike, but it can still be folded. The ICE Compact Flat Twist fold is one of the many innovations that ICE has brought to the recumbent world. The fold is based around a lightweight heat-treated aluminium hinge on the main frame. All ICE trikes (except the VTX) can be folded for transporting in a car and for storing your trike.
Yes. The Full Fat uses ICE's Compact Flat Twist fold, so it collapses down in under 30 seconds for the back of a car or for storage.

notes: Recumbent fat-tire trike, built to order; sold with or without e-assist (recorded the e-assist version). Maker product page headline 'PRICES FROM: £4,700 | $6,650 | €5,150' is the non-assist trike. Maker contradicts itself on motor: product page says 'available exclusively with the NEW Shimano STEPS EP8', while the 2026 USD price list's entry e-assist build uses 'EP6 CARGO' (both 85Nm / 630Wh). Price list read in-browser via pdf.js; quote is extracted text with double spaces. Full Fat product page has no speed line, so speed/class come from the maker's Shimano e-assist page. No range figure; sized by X-seam, not height. Weight is the lightest non-assist build. Laid Back Cycles quotes come from its FAQ accordion text.
